nodes.label: buildWeekReport()
nodes.rationale: Draws a clean, printable, pay-dispute-ready weekly sheet: daily tallies with the cornice code/qty/rate/units behind each entry, plus the full pay calculation. Runs the same layout function twice - once with ctx=null just to measure the total height needed, then again on a properly-sized canvas - so the two passes can never drift out of sync.

nodes.label: DAYS (Wed-Tue pay week)
nodes.rationale: DAYS = ['Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat','Sun','Mon','Tue'] - the pay week runs Wed to Tue, with all 7 days selectable.

nodes.label: isDayOffDate()
nodes.rationale: A day defaults to off on Saturday/Sunday and working on every other day, unless explicitly overridden by the day record's off flag.

nodes.label: removeEntry()
nodes.rationale: Deletes an entry by id from the active day, marks data dirty, and re-renders.

nodes.label: render()
nodes.rationale: Master re-render: redraws the week label, day chips, entry form, day ledger, week table, and pay summary.

nodes.label: renderEntryForm()
nodes.rationale: Renders the day-off toggle state and disables the whole entry form when the active day is marked off (existing entries stay, new ones are blocked).

nodes.label: renderDayChips()
nodes.rationale: Renders the 7 day chips with active / has-entries / day-off states; tapping a chip switches the active day.

nodes.label: renderDayLedger()
nodes.rationale: Renders the active day's entry rows (code, qty x rate, units, delete button) and the day total line.

nodes.label: renderSummary()
nodes.rationale: Renders the Estimate panel: working days, base pay, total units, unit target, remaining units, extra pay, and the estimated total pay.

nodes.label: renderWeekLabel()
nodes.rationale: Renders 'Week of X - Y (current)' for the week currently being viewed.

nodes.label: renderWeekTable()
nodes.rationale: Renders per-day entry counts and unit totals, striking through off days, plus a WEEK total row showing the working-day count.

nodes.label: roundRectPath()
nodes.rationale: Canvas rounded-rectangle path helper used by the pay summary report.

nodes.label: state.settings (pay settings)
nodes.rationale: Pay settings: {hourly: 28.5, hoursPerDay: 8, unitsPerDay: 36, extraRate: 3.8}; editable via the Pay Settings modal.

nodes.label: unitsFor()
nodes.rationale: Units for an entry = qty x rate, rounded to 2 decimals. 'Units' = length made x units-per-length rate recorded at time of entry.

nodes.label: wednesdayOf()
nodes.rationale: Finds the Wednesday that starts the pay period (Wed-Tue week) containing a given date.

nodes.label: workingDaysCount()
nodes.rationale: Counts the week's days that aren't marked off; drives both base pay and the unit target.

nodes.label: Pay calculation (base + extra over unit target)
nodes.norm_label: pay calculation (base + extra over unit target)
nodes.rationale: Estimated pay = base pay + extra pay. Base pay = hourly x hoursPerDay x working days. Unit target = unitsPerDay x working days. Extra pay = max(0, totalUnits - target) x extraRate. Base pay and the unit target both multiply by however many days this week aren't marked Day Off.

nodes.label: Cornice Ledger (standalone HTML app)
nodes.rationale: Standalone single-file, mobile-first (480px, dark theme) pay tracker for cornice makers. No browser database - everything lives in memory for the session; cornice_ledger.json is the only persistence. Pay week runs Wed-Tue. Tracks cornice entries (code, length made, units/length), day-offs, an editable rate book, and an estimated weekly pay; exports a shareable JPEG pay summary.

nodes.label: applyDbObject()
nodes.rationale: Inverse of buildDbObject: parses the JSON back into state (settings + ISO-keyed days with entries), regenerating entry ids.

nodes.label: buildDbObject()
nodes.rationale: Serializes state to a deliberately human-readable v2 JSON: human date keys ('wednesday 12/08/2026'), entry keys 'CODE (rate)' with same code+rate quantities merged, _off flags for day-offs, plus settings and app metadata.

nodes.label: exportWeekAsJPEG()
nodes.rationale: Two-pass canvas render at 2x scale for sharper output, exported as a downloadable JPEG named cornice_pay_summary_<weekStart>.jpg.

nodes.label: cornice_ledger.json (persistence file)
nodes.rationale: The app's only persistence layer. Nothing is saved automatically; Save downloads it and Load opens a copy back in. The user must keep the file somewhere safe (e.g. next to the HTML in Files) and load it each time the app is reopened.

nodes.label: loadDBFile()
nodes.rationale: Reads a chosen cornice_ledger.json, confirms that it replaces everything currently shown (all weeks and settings), applies it, and re-renders.

nodes.label: saveDB()
nodes.rationale: Downloads the serialized state as cornice_ledger.json via a Blob anchor click; marks data clean.

nodes.label: setDayOffDate()
nodes.rationale: Overrides a day's off/working status, marks data dirty, and re-renders.

nodes.label: showConfirm()
nodes.rationale: Promise-based custom confirm dialog replacing native confirm(), which can be unreliable in sandboxed views.

nodes.label: state (in-memory database)
nodes.rationale: In-memory state: {weekStart, days, settings}. state.days is keyed by plain ISO date and is, per the source comment, the ENTIRE database - populated only by loading a cornice_ledger.json file and read out again only when saving one.

nodes.label: toast()
nodes.rationale: Transient toast notification at the bottom of the screen; auto-hides after 1.6s.

nodes.label: tryAutoLoad()
nodes.rationale: Best-effort fetch of ./cornice_ledger.json on init - works when the page is served from a real web server, silently fails under plain file:// (e.g. Safari) where the Load button is used instead.

nodes.label: Unsaved-changes tracking (markDirty/markClean)
nodes.rationale: Dirty tracking with a red unsaved dot in the title bar. Because nothing is saved automatically, a beforeunload handler warns that unsaved data will be lost on reload.

nodes.label: File-only persistence (no browser DB)
nodes.rationale: Deliberate design: no browser database at all (no localStorage/IndexedDB) - everything lives in memory for the session and cornice_ledger.json is the only place data lives. Trade-off: nothing survives a reload unless the user has saved the file.

nodes.label: categories (live rate book)
nodes.rationale: Live rate categories - array of {name, codes:{CODE:[rates]}} - the editable source of truth. Session-only: always starts from DEFAULT_CATEGORIES and resets on reload because the app has no database to persist edits.

nodes.label: categoryOfCode()
nodes.rationale: Finds which rate-book category a given code belongs to.

nodes.label: DEFAULT_CATEGORIES (default rate table)
nodes.rationale: Hardcoded default rate table grouped into the same series/sections as the original sheet (P, W, 200-900 Series). Each cornice code maps to one or more units-per-length rates (multiple rates = multiple moulds). Seeds the rate book on first run; afterwards the user's edited copy is what's used.

nodes.label: deleteCategory()
nodes.rationale: Deletes a section after confirmation; its cornice codes are moved to an 'Uncategorized' section rather than lost.

nodes.label: init()
nodes.rationale: Init IIFE: loads the default rate table, attempts auto-load of cornice_ledger.json, sets the active day to today's weekday, and performs the first render.

nodes.label: loadRateTable()
nodes.rationale: Session-only rate table load: always starts from the hardcoded DEFAULT_CATEGORIES. Edits made in the Rate Book work for this session but reset on reload because the app now has no database to save them to.

nodes.label: openCodeModal()
nodes.rationale: Opens the add/edit cornice modal, prefilling the code, its category, and one rate row per mould (a code can have multiple moulds/rates).

nodes.label: RATES / RATE_KEYS (flat lookup cache)
nodes.rationale: Flat lookup cache rebuilt from `categories` whenever it changes; enables direct rate lookup by code and prefix-match suggestions.

nodes.label: rebuildFlatRates()
nodes.rationale: Rebuilds the flat RATES/RATE_KEYS cache from the categories array.

nodes.label: renameCategory()
nodes.rationale: Renames a rate-book section via a text prompt, guarding against duplicate section names.

nodes.label: renderCategoryList()
nodes.rationale: Renders the Rate Book: collapsible category blocks with codes and rates, search filtering (auto-expands sections while searching, hides empty ones), rename/delete actions per section, and add-cornice rows.

nodes.label: saveRateTable()
nodes.rationale: Rebuilds the flat rate cache after Rate Book edits; there is no persistent storage - the rate book is session-only.

nodes.label: showTextPrompt()
nodes.rationale: Promise-based custom text-input dialog replacing native prompt(), which can be unreliable in sandboxed views.

nodes.label: generate-agent-files.js
nodes.rationale: node_modules/next/dist/server/lib/generate-agent-files.js - the file where the agent-rules block generation is verified.

nodes.label: next dev (agent-file generator)
nodes.rationale: The `next dev` command that writes and re-adds the nextjs-agent-rules block to AGENTS.md.

nodes.label: next/font (Geist)
nodes.rationale: next/font automatically optimizes and loads Geist, a font family for Vercel.

nodes.label: Vercel Platform
nodes.rationale: The recommended (easiest) way to deploy the Next.js app, from the creators of Next.js.

nodes.label: Next.js Agent Rules Block
nodes.rationale: This repo's Next.js version has breaking changes - APIs, conventions, and file structure may all differ from an agent's training data. Agents must read the relevant guide in node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing any code and heed deprecation notices. The block is written and re-added by `next dev`; removing it from a diff only re-creates the uncommitted change, so committing it with the work keeps the tree clean.

nodes.label: Next.js Project (create-next-app)
nodes.rationale: Next.js project bootstrapped with create-next-app. Dev server via npm/yarn/pnpm/bun dev at localhost:3000. Uses next/font to automatically optimize and load the Geist font. Deploys to the Vercel Platform.

nodes.label: addEntry()
nodes.rationale: Validates code/qty/rate, blocks entry on day-off days, pushes {id, code, qty, rate} into the active day, marks data dirty, clears the form, and re-renders.

nodes.label: lookupRates()
nodes.rationale: Returns the array of known rates for a normalized code, or null if the code isn't on the rate sheet.

nodes.label: normalizeCode()
nodes.rationale: Normalizes user-typed cornice codes: trims, uppercases, strips whitespace and curly quotes so code entry and lookup are lenient.

nodes.label: updateForCode()
nodes.rationale: On code entry: a single known rate auto-fills the rate input; multiple moulds show tap-to-pick A/B/C variant chips (first preselected); an unknown code shows a 'custom' hint and the user types a rate.

nodes.label: updateSuggestions()
nodes.rationale: Prefix-match autocomplete over known codes (max 8), each suggestion showing its rate(s); picking one fills the code and advances focus to qty.
